input.question: In Ghost e2e tests, what is the purpose of passing resource name strings to `fixtureManager.init()`, and what happens if no fixture set exists for `audit_logs`?

options.A: The strings configure which HTTP routes are registered; if `audit_logs` is not passed, the route will return 404.
options.B: The strings seed the test database with pre-defined fixture data for named resource sets; without an `audit_logs` fixture set, browse tests will always receive an empty array and cannot validate audit log object structure using matchers.
options.C: The strings configure which model classes are loaded; without `audit_logs`, the model's `findPage` method will not be available.
options.D: The strings select which database migrations to run; without an `audit_logs` entry, the table will not be created.
